item.text: I’m using the frontend-design skill to give Maya’s site a coastal, field-notebook character: cool paper tones, blue ink, and illustrations drawn from her work with data. I’ll build the complete page, including responsive navigation, theme switching, and working writing filters.

The design pairs blue-gray paper with cobalt ink and a tide-chart illustration, with each project shown through its own interface sketch. I’ve kept the layout spacious and left aligned, using a serif for the introduction and article alongside a clear sans serif for navigation and project details.
